title: Better Answers, Weaker Evidence Control: Evidence Bypass in On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.01967v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) can improve answer accuracy while weakening responsiveness to supporting evidence. We investigate this separation in scientific-document question answering through matched document interventions that change the supported answer while preserving the question and unrelated context. We identify evidence bypass: a student retains an originally correct answer after the document changes to support a different one. On QASPER with a Qwen3-4B student, standard OPD raises original-document accuracy by 3.4 percentage points, lowers counterfactual accuracy by 5.3 points, and increases bypass by 15.7 points; the same directional pattern appears on PeerQA. Controlled perturbations localize the shift to answer-critical evidence, and bypass grows with the student's pre-distillation closed-book preference for the original answer. translated_title: 更好的答案，更弱的证据控制：在线策略蒸馏中的证据绕过现象
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）可以在提高答案准确率的同时，削弱模型对支持性证据的响应能力。我们通过匹配的文档干预在科学文档问答任务中研究了这种分离现象——这些干预在保持问题和不相关上下文不变的同时，改变文档所支持的答案。我们识别出“证据绕过”现象：当文档被修改为支持另一个答案后，学生模型仍保留原本正确的答案。在QASPER数据集上使用Qwen3-4B作为学生模型时，标准OPD将原始文档准确率提高了3.4个百分点，将反事实准确率降低了5.3个百分点，并将绕过现象增加了15.7个百分点；同样的趋势模式也出现在PeerQA数据集上。受控扰动实验将这种偏移定位于对答案至关重要的证据，且绕过程度随学生模型蒸馏前对原始答案的闭卷偏好增强而增长。一项对教师目标、特权信息、散度和监督密度的因子化研究（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现在线策略蒸馏虽能提升答案准确率，却会引发“证据绕过”现象——学生模型在文档证据被修改后仍坚持原答案，揭示出蒸馏过程会削弱模型对支持证据的依赖。
en_tdlr: On-policy distillation improves answer accuracy but induces "evidence bypass," where the student model ignores document evidence changes and retains its original answer, revealing that distillation weakens grounding in supporting evidence.
